description: §22.4.1 (S459 round 3) — compile-time `emit()` output is held to the same CLOSED attribute list as runtime `meta.emit`: `online=` is on no list, so it is E-META-EVAL-002.
rationale: §22.4.1: an attribute in `emit()` output SHALL carry a name on the closed attribute list of §22.12; any other name is `E-META-EVAL-002`. (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S458 "a" + PA addendum 3 (S459 review of a7480c675))
